name: Shallow Sea

categories.label: Orange Ecosystem card
categories.hint: VP per the condition on your chosen Orange Ecosystem card.

categories.label: Blue Ecosystem card
categories.hint: VP per the condition on your chosen Blue Ecosystem card.

categories.label: Completed tiles and incomplete Sealife
categories.labelVi: Ô hoàn thành và Sealife chưa hoàn thành
categories.hint: Enter VP of each completed Coral/Sealife tile; incomplete Sealife scores the lower value shown. Incomplete Coral scores 0.

categories.label: Different completed Sealife tiles
categories.labelVi: Số loại Sealife khác nhau đã hoàn thành
categories.hint: 2 VP per DIFFERENT completed Sealife tile.

categories.label: Incomplete fish: adjacent completed Coral
categories.labelVi: Cá chưa hoàn thành: san hô kề cạnh
categories.hint: 1 VP per adjacent Completed Coral tile for each Incomplete Fish (a coral can count for several fish). Enter the total count.

categories.label: Remaining Seashells (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Vỏ sò còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, the win is shared.

endCondition.description: Game ends when each player's Ocean has only 4 empty spaces left (17 turns each).

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Solo mode (Lionfish penalty) and Achievement scenarios not modelled. Ecosystem card formulas vary per card, so they are scorer inputs. Rulebook scoring order: Ecosystem cards, tiles top row down, 2 VP per different Sealife, incomplete fish.
